tooltips.enableProvider: Enable or disable this provider. When disabled, agents won't use this provider for inference.
tooltips.apiKey: Secret key to authenticate with the provider's API. Obtain it from the provider's dashboard.
tooltips.defaultModel: The AI model used by default for this provider when no specific model is selected by the agent.
tooltips.testConnection: Checks if the API Key is valid and the provider is reachable.
tooltips.ollamaStatus: Connection status with local Ollama (port 11434). Ollama must be installed and running.
tooltips.mcpName: Identifier name for this MCP. Use only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
tooltips.mcpType: Stdio: runs a local process via command line. HTTP/SSE: connects to a remote server via URL.
tooltips.mcpValue: For stdio: full command with arguments (e.g. npx @mcp/server-name). For HTTP: MCP server base URL.
tooltips.whatsappUrl: URL of the Evolution API instance. Usually http://localhost:8080 for local installs.
tooltips.whatsappKey: Evolution API API Key. Generated in the Evolution API admin panel.
tooltips.whatsappInstance: Name of the WhatsApp instance created in Evolution API.
tooltips.brevoKey: Brevo API Key (formerly Sendinblue). Get it at app.brevo.com > SMTP & API.
tooltips.resendKey: Resend API Key (re_xxxxxxxxx). Get it at resend.com/api-keys.
tooltips.senderName: Name that will appear in the 'From' field of sent emails.
tooltips.senderAddress: Sender email address. Must be verified in Brevo.
tooltips.telegramToken: Telegram bot token. Obtain it by creating a bot with @BotFather on Telegram.
tooltips.telegramChatId: Operator chat ID. Send /getid to @userinfobot on Telegram to find your ID.
tooltips.hitlTimeout: Maximum time (in minutes) the system waits for a HITL approval before marking it as expired.
tooltips.financialInterval: Interval (in minutes) to resend alerts about pending financial approvals.
tooltips.maxBodySize: Maximum accepted size in bytes per request. 1048576 = 1 MB. Increase for larger uploads.
tooltips.backupExport: Generates a JSON file with all settings (except secrets). Useful for migrating to another server.
tooltips.backupImport: Restores settings from an exported JSON. Secrets are never automatically imported.
tooltips.transparenciaKey: Portal da Transparência Federal API Key. Request at portaldatransparencia.gov.br/api-de-dados.
tooltips.datajudKey: DataJud API Key (TJDFT/CNJ). Required to query judicial process data.
tooltips.metaToken: Meta Business Access Token. Required for official WhatsApp Business API integration.
tooltips.chromaUrl: ChromaDB server URL. Used as a vector database for agent memory and RAG.
tooltips.webhookUrl: URL where the system sends event notifications (qualified leads, closed deals, etc).
tooltips.webhookSecret: Key used to sign webhook payloads (HMAC-SHA256). Validate on your receiving server.

ollama.unreachableSubtitle: Could not connect to Ollama on port 11434
ollama.cause2: The Ollama service is not running
ollama.cause3: Port 11434 is blocked (firewall or another process)
